cases.description: A game day at the fastest speed, steady 60 Hz frames, from midnight.
The dual run's frame-time cycle (60, 30 and 120 Hz frames, a 400 ms and a 3 s stall) at the fastest speed.
The steady clock at 144 Hz and the fastest speed.
Normal speed at 30 Hz through the lunch crawl.
The slowest speed with jittery 8 to 41 ms frames.
Speed 10, then 120, then paused, then 30 with the steady clock, then 120 again: minutes owed under another mode are dropped, a pause owes nothing.
A host still busy with its last batch owes frames without stepping them (the carry hits the 30-minute cap), then steps.
Long stalls at the fastest speed, each capped at 30 owed minutes.
